 Bar 45
 
 
 
 
 Good Times, Great Food, and the Best Views in Gulf Shores
 Bar 45 Restaurant and Bar is your local hangout for great food, cold drinks, and a laid-back vibe—right at ONE Club. Whether you’re winding down after golf, catching up with friends, or just looking for a spot to watch the game, you’ll find plenty of reasons to come back.

Enjoy a menu filled with classic favorites and tasty bar bites, plus cold drafts, creative cocktails, and wine for every taste. We’ve got happy hour specials and weekly entertainment that keep the energy going, whether it’s game day or just a Tuesday.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Dine With Us
 
 Open to Everyone—No Membership Required
 Game Room and Golf Simulator
 Perfect for Happy Hour, Casual Meals, or Big Group Gatherings
 Friendly Staff in a Relaxed, Lively Atmosphere
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Host With Us
 
 Flexible Spaces for Groups Big & Small, Indoors or Out
 Custom Food & Drink Packages
 Private Party Tenting, Poolside Cabanas, and Outdoor Bar Options
 Access to Amenities: Golf, Pools, Fitness, and More
 
 
 View More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Dedicated Event Manager to Help You Plan Every Detail
 30+ Acres of Green Space
 
 
 
 

 
 
 #1 Sports Bar & Entertainment Venue in Gulf Shores
 Bar 45 Restaurant & Bar is the best sports bar and entertainment venue in Gulf Shores. With big screen TVs, great draft selections, and awesome bar bites and easy eats, its the place where locals meet.

Enjoy your favorite beverage from our fully stocked bar while watching great sports or enjoying the beautiful golf course views.

Meet up with friends and family in our game room and Media Simulator room - more than 100 simulation games, kids games, golf courses, football and so much more.
 
 
 
 
 Private Events

 View the gallery of our 5,000 square foot restaurant and 15,000 square foot clubhouse perfect for hosting your next event.

 Event Venue
 
 
 
 
 The Perfect Setting for Every Occasion
 Looking for a venue that’s anything but ordinary? At Bar 45, you’re getting more than just a space—you’re getting energy, personality, and a crew that knows how to make any occasion a hit. From milestone birthdays to company outings, sports banquets to bridal showers, Bar 45 is where people come to celebrate in style (and without the stress).
 
 
 
 
 Host Your Event 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What Can You Celebrate Here?
 
 Team dinners before the big game
 Rehearsal dinners and engagement parties
 Fantasy league drafts and game-watching nights
 Retirement toasts and graduation bashes
 
 
 View More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Family reunions
 Milestone birthdays
 Holiday shindigs, themed parties, and more!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What Our Space Offers
 
 Room for groups big and small (from 10 to 200+)
 Indoor & outdoor options (great for any weather)
 Game room, simulators, and built-in fun—no extra charge
 Access to resort perks like pools, golf, and more (ask about our add-ons!)
 
 
 View More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Friendly, flexible staff ready to make your life easier
 
 
 
 

 
 
 Easy Planning, Zero Headaches
 Planning an event at Bar 45 is a breeze. Just share your vision—we’ll do the heavy lifting. Our team can help with:

- Custom food and drink packages (think: sliders, flatbreads, wings, and more)
- Specialty cocktails and signature sips
- Set-up, clean-up, and everything in between
- Audio/visual, music, and entertainment recommendations
- Decorating, themes, and creative details to make it all pop
 
 
 
 
 Host Your Event 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Spaces for Any Occasion
 Make your next event the one everyone’s talking about. Book with Bar 45 and we’ll make sure it’s anything but ordinary.
